entries.en: Deliver the feral lizard meat to Bhol Bol.
I have seen you around, traveler. You like making yourself useful, yes? There is work for you, if you are willing.
entries.fr: Graaah... Groh ? Dis-moi, voyageu, tu as l'air fort, groui, très fort. Tu pourrais sans doute me débarrasser  qui rôde dans le coin. C'est un animal domestique qui s'est enfui et est devenu sauvage, groui.

entries.en: One of the lizards that I raised for meat escaped some time past. I thought it would have been eaten by predators by now, but a miner from Twine said that it attacked her. It seems to have grown into quite the brute.
entries.fr: Je pensais que les autres créatures des environs le dévoreraient, mais c'est pas le cas, non, pas le cas du tout. À cause de lui, plusieurs travailleurs des mines de Queues-liées ont été blessés, groui... J'ai besoin de ton aide, j'en ai besoin !
entries.ja:
魔物に食われたと思ってたけど、しっかり成長して、
トゥワインの鉱山労働者を怪我させるほどになったヨ。
もう僕の手には負えないネ……。

entries.en: Which brings me to the job in question. I want you to put a stop to its mischief. Kill it, in other words. I would recommend softening its hide first with a splash of this oil.

entries.en: Once you have taken care of it, bring me its meat. No point letting it go to waste.

entries.en: I heard it was prowling around the outskirts of the village, to the west. And I will know from the smell if you attempt to fob me off with meat from another lizard, so do not even try!
entries.fr: D'après ce que m'a dit un marchand ambulant,  aurait été aperçu à l'ouest du village, oui ! Je compte sur toi, voyageu !
entries.ja:
「」、
村の西で見かけた話、行商人からよく聞くヨ！
退治よろしくお願いネ、旅人さん！

entries.en: Most of the lizards look the same, so we tell them apart by their scent. This one smells like burned leather, which matches what the miner from Twine told us.

entries.en: Very good. That beast put us through a lot of trouble, so it is about time we had something to show for it.

……おお、倒してくれたネ。
ありがとネ、旅人さん。

entries.en: They are usually quite harmless when they are young, but this one was a vicious little bastard, even then.
entries.fr: Tu sais,  était tout mimi avant, mais après s'être enfui, il était devenu très violent, groui, très violent. Au point même qu'il attaquait les humains...
entries.ja:
あのも、小さい頃はかわいかったネ。
でも、いつの頃から、暴れん坊になったヨ。
それがヒトを襲うまでになるなんてネ……。

entries.en: Heh! This serves him right for mauling passersby. If he had any sense, he would have disappeared for good.
entries.fr: Il n'y avait donc pas d'autres choix que de l'abattre, non, pas d'autres choix, malheureusement...

entries.en: Anyway, I will dry this meat and send it to Twine by way of apology. For you, this should be an ample reward.
